controls.institutional_authority_retained: The accountable authority for governed data and outcomes remains The House regardless of provider arrangements.
controls.continuity_dependency: Continuity of governed service must not depend on a single unrecoverable provider.
controls.data_return_requirement: Governed data must be returnable to institutional control in a usable form with integrity.
controls.deletion_evidence_requirement: Provider deletion must be evidenced, including residual and backup copies.
controls.residual_copy_posture: Residual and backup copies held by a provider must be accounted for and disposed of under evidence.
controls.independent_assurance_dependency: Provider certification is not service assurance; independent assurance evidence is required.
